No fatal findings.

### Nonfatal

- `cor-orthogonal-and-unitary-operators-form-groups-and-have-unit-determinant-modulus`, `[L1]` and proof step 1.1 ([item](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/cor-orthogonal-and-unitary-operators-form-groups-and-have-unit-determinant-modulus.md:36)): `[L1]` states only that an orthogonal or unitary operator satisfies \(T^*T=TT^*=I\). Step 1.1 uses the converse after proving \((ST)^*(ST)=I\) to conclude that \(ST\) is again orthogonal/unitary. The cited theorem’s full Statement does supply that converse—\(T^*T=I\) is equivalent to norm preservation and implies invertibility ([dependency](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-finite-dimensional-isometry-characterisations.md:24))—but `[L1]` omits the direction the step invokes. This is an immediate, under-30-second bridge, so **nonfatal**.
